mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_table_permission (role_id, module_code, can_view, can_add, can_edit, can_delete, can_export, can_import, can_print, remark, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.roleId}, #{item.moduleCode}, #{item.canView}, #{item.canAdd}, #{item.canEdit}, #{item.canDelete}, #{item.canExport}, #{item.canImport}, #{item.canPrint}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createUserId}, #{item.createUserName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON CONFLICT (role_id, module_code) DO UPDATE SET can_view = EXCLUDED.can_view, can_add = EXCLUDED.can_add, can_edit = EXCLUDED.can_edit, can_delete = EXCLUDED.can_delete, can_export = EXCLUDED.can_export, can_import = EXCLUDED.can_import, can_print = EXCLUDED.can_print, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT tp.*, r.role_name FROM t_table_permission tp LEFT JOIN t_role r ON tp.role_id = r.role_id ORDER BY tp.role_id, tp.module_code
